title: Hiking Emergency Checklist Printable, First Aid Kit List, What to Do If Lost, Emergency Info Card, Trail Safety PDF, Hiker Gift
description:
The kit to build once, the checks before every trip, and the steps to follow when something goes wrong, in one printable document.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- The Kit: the emergency kit that lives in your pack, with a twice-yearly check
- Before Every Trip: the two-minute emergency prep
- If You're Lost: eight steps, in order, written to be read cold and stressed
- If Someone's Hurt: six steps
- Weather and Darkness: storm, cold, heat, whiteout, dark, rising water
- Information Card: fill in, print, keep in the first-aid pouch

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions, print-ready
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
General information for recreational hikers. Not a substitute for wilderness first-aid training or emergency services. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable guides at hikesupplyco.com
